name: Westside Trailer Park (Mott)
note: City of Mott RV park on the west edge of town: full-service sites (water, sewer, 30 or 50-amp) at $30 a night, reservations by phone through the city. A small, plain lot. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: discovermott.com/parks-recreation (City of Mott) read 2026-10-03: 'Westside Trailer Park - $30.00 per night full service rate, 30 or 50 amp, sewer, water ... For reservations contact Sherran Mayer, 701-260-2675'. City-run = local (no price/quality gate). Google 'Westside Trailer Park' pin 46.3706,-102.3348; satellite shows a gravel lot with a few trailers. RV Life lists it under the neighbouring Mott American Legion Park name
